question: Who is the author of the book 'The Room on the Roof'?
solution: The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Ruskin Bond** is the celebrated author of the novel **'The Room on the Roof'**, which was his first novel. • He wrote **'The Room on the Roof'** at the age of **17**, which won him the prestigious **John Llewellyn Rhys Prize** in **1957**. • The book is a semi-autobiographical work and reflects Bond's own experiences as a teenager in India. • The story revolves around a young boy named **Rusty**, who struggles with his identity and finds solace in friendships after running away from his guardian's house. • **Ruskin Bond** is renowned for his ability to depict the beauty of nature and the simplicity of life, especially in the Indian context.
